content: The FDI World Dental Federation notation is a system widely utilized by dentists across the globe to associate specific information with an individual tooth. This notation system was developed by the FDI World Dental Federation and is also referred to as the ISO-3950 notation. In this system, the patient's right side corresponds to the left side of the notation chart. However, the terms left and right on the chart are aligned with the patient's actual left and right sides, respectively.
